_metadata.source: Solid state physics textbooks and literature
_metadata.description: Physical principles of defects in crystals
_metadata.citation: Freysoldt et al., Rev. Mod. Phys. 86, 253 (2014)

vacancy.relaxation_effects: Neighboring atoms relax inward toward vacancy
vacancy.minimum_separation_rule: Vacancies should be >5 Å apart to avoid interaction
vacancy.electronic_effects: Creates localized states in band gap for semiconductors

substitution.formation_mechanism: Replace host atom with dopant atom
substitution.site_preference: Dopant prefers sites of similar size/valence
substitution.minimum_separation_rule: Dopants should be >5 Å apart for dilute limit
substitution.size_mismatch_effects: Large size mismatch causes local strain

octahedral.description: Center of octahedron formed by 6 atoms

tetrahedral.description: Center of tetrahedron formed by 4 atoms

interstitial.diffusion: Interstitials typically have lower migration barriers than vacancies

antisite.description: Atom on wrong sublattice in compound
antisite.example: Ga on As site in GaAs (Ga_As antisite)

frenkel_pair.formation_mechanism: Atom moves from lattice site to interstitial position
frenkel_pair.formation_energy: Sum of vacancy and interstitial formation energies minus binding
frenkel_pair.recombination: Can recombine if vacancy and interstitial are close

schottky_defect.description: Paired cation and anion vacancies in ionic crystals
schottky_defect.formation_mechanism: Remove cation-anion pair to maintain charge neutrality
